title: Français 3944
contents: Royal instructions concerning an attack on the Milanese, Savoyard preparations, and an attack on Rives.
status: 1/2 pages transcribed; 1 more in part; 2/2 cipher pages deciphered
fields: 81 symbols/codes: 51 letter signs, 30 syllable or word codes.
Historical interlinear plaintext on the same letter, ff99r–v.

excerpt: **croions que les forces presentes des [Ennemis] et les considerations de M. de Savoye pour la conservation de ses estats nous imposeront une loy assez absolue pour ce regard**
translation: We believe that the enemy’s present forces and Monsieur de Savoy’s concern for preserving his states will impose a fairly absolute rule on us in this respect.
